p01.text: Every island has its own world...

p02.text: But what if these worlds could share what they know?

p03.text: Data sharing allows information to move between systems.

p04.text: Interoperability helps different systems understand and use that information.

p05.text: Different systems. Shared data. One connected world.

p06.text: Visit us at the Data Sharing and Interoperability booth. Meet us at DSI!
